name: family-tree
description: Private family-history site on Cloudflare Workers + D1, built from a GEDCOM export.

scripts.db:load: python3 tools/guard_load.py --remote --legacy && wrangler d1 execute family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --file build/seed.sql
scripts.db:load:local: python3 tools/guard_load.py --local --legacy && wrangler d1 execute family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local --file build/seed.sql
scripts.db:counts: wrangler d1 execute family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM people) AS people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM families) AS families, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM findings) AS findings"
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local
scripts.db:import: python3 tools/guard_load.py --remote && wrangler d1 execute family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --remote --file build/seed-app.sql
scripts.db:import:local: python3 tools/guard_load.py --local && wrangler d1 execute family-tree -c wrangler.local.jsonc --local --file build/seed-app.sql
scripts.upload:ci: node tools/ci_config.mjs && wrangler versions upload -c wrangler.ci.jsonc
